fixes.explanation: Footstool is a real Bible word, friend. Isaiah, the prophet, says the earth is God's footstool in Isaiah 66:1. But in this verse Jesus says swearing by heaven means swearing by "God’s throne and by the One who sits on it." So the word here is throne.

Wise would be nice, but Jesus doesn't say that. He says they make the convert "…twice as much a son of hell as you are." That's what He says the effort produces. It's a heavy woe, and the text says it plainly.

Gold it is. Jesus quotes their rule: "…if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath." In that same rule, they say an oath by the temple means nothing, but an oath by the gold binds you. Jesus calls them "blind guides" for it. Then He asks which is greater.

That's it. Jesus says, "You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel." A gnat is tiny and a camel is enormous. They're careful about the small thing and they swallow the giant one. Right before this, He says they have disregarded justice, mercy and faithfulness, so I think that's the kind of big thing they miss.
True. Jesus says, "Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well." Inside first, and then the outside follows. The order is the whole point.

It's true, actually. Jesus says, "First clean the inside of the cup and dish, so that the outside may become clean as well." So the inside comes first, and the outside follows. That's exactly what He says in Matthew 23:26.

It's actually true, friend. Jesus says, "…on the outside you appear to be righteous, but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness." Those are His words in Matthew 23:28. He's spelling out what the whitewashed tombs meant.

Yes. Jesus says, "So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets." They had said they wouldn't have been partners with their fathers in shedding the prophets' blood. Jesus says that same saying testifies they are those fathers' sons. The murder of prophets is heavy, so I'll say it straight.
